Question: A carrier with amplitude 4 volts and frequencyf_c= 2MHz is frequency modulated by a modulating signal m(t) = sin 1000\pit. The amplitude of the modulating signal is 2 volts and the frequency deviation was found to be equal to 1 kHz. If the amplitude and frequency of the modulating signal are increased to 8 volts and 2 kHz respectively, write an expression for the new modulated signal.

Options: 
A. v(t) = 4cos(4\pi × 10^6 t + 2 sin2\pi × 2000t)
B. v(t) = 8cos(4π × 10^6 t + 4 sin2π × 1000t)
C. v(t) = 8cos(2π × 10^6 t + 4 sin2π × 2000t)
D. v(t) = 8cos(4π × 10^6 t + 8 sin2π × 2000t)
E. v(t) = 4cos(4π × 10^6 t + 16 sin2π × 2000t)
F. v(t) = 4cos(4π × 10^6 t + 4 sin2π × 1000t)
G. v(t) = 4cos(2\pi × 10^6 t + 2 sin2\pi × 2000t)
H. v(t) = 4cos(4\pi × 10^6 t + 4 sin2\pi × 2000t)
I. v(t) = 8cos(4\pi × 10^6 t + 2 sin2\pi × 2000t)
J. v(t) = 4cos(4π × 10^6 t + 8 sin2π × 2000t)

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.
